title: Sants · El Nucli
description: The walk from the Plaça de Sants metro up Carrer de Riego and the Plaça d'Osca, across the Passeig de Sant Antoni past the closed Palau Balañà, and up Carrer de Santa Caterina to El Nucli on Carrer de Valladolid (OpenStreetMap, turned so the shop faces the camera). Then inside the shop: the wall of boxes and the counter before the wine-red wall, the play hall's green tables with games left half played, and the back room behind the curtain with its round table.

steps.caption: Carrer de Valladolid: El Nucli's lit front, the only warm window in the street
Close: the wine-red front, the name on the fascia, the round sign hung out over the door, the warm light on the pavement
Entrar en El Nucli: the street door opens into the shop
Carrer de Santa Caterina down from Valladolid, Casa Astor on the corner
The Passeig de Sant Antoni and the Palau Balañà, closed since 2020, its letters still up
The Passeig: someone on every bench, every head turned the same way
Carrer de Riego: a narrow pedestrian street of painted shutters
The Plaça d'Osca and its terraces
Up from the L1 at Plaça de Sants (the Riego entrance) on Carrer de Sants
Sants from above: Valladolid at the top, the Passeig across the middle, Riego and the Plaça d'Osca down to Carrer de Sants
Inside El Nucli: hydraulic tiles, the wall of boxes, the counter before the wine wall
Close: the wall of game boxes, stacked flat, standing on edge or face out
The play hall: green walls, six felt tables with games left half played under the pendants
The back room behind the curtain: stock shelves, unopened boxes, the round table under a bare bulb (Bernat's seat)
El Nucli from above: the shop, the play hall and the back room
Salir a la calle: back on Carrer de Valladolid, in front of the shop
